sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Very close to P. aequalis, differing in the smaller size and the longer segment 2 of the soldier antenna.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head and labrum yellowish brown to brown, the rest of the body paler. Head and abdomen densely hairy, pronotum sparsely hairy. Head oval, the anterolateral margins not much narrowed; sides curved outwards, the posterior margin projecting forward in the middle and with a weak notch on each side. Fontanelle spot as in the other species of the genus. Labrum slightly rectangular, the apical margin translucent and convex, with microscopic hairs and a few bristles below. Antennae 13-segmented, segment 3 shorter than segment 2 and about as long as segment 4. Mandibles strongly bent at about the middle, ending in an incurved point, the inner margin curved outwards. Left mandible with 2 marginal teeth of unequal size, right mandible with 1 broad-based marginal tooth. Anterior part of the postmentum distinctly bilobed, the maximum width almost twice the width of the waist; the whole body densely hairy. Pronotum far narrower than the head, the anterior margin projecting forward in the middle, the posterior margin weakly notched.
